name: Homiez Baller Bucket | Watermelon Zkittlez
description:
Concentrates are where the Homiez magic really shines.

Packed with the best parts of cannabis, they come in all kinds of textures and flavors, each offering a unique way to elevate your sesh. Dab ’em, sprinkle ’em into a joint for an extra kick, or dial in the vibes by infusing them into edibles—however you roll, concentrates, let you customize your high and keep things anything but basic.
